The project addresses the lack of accessible, engaging information about abandoned spacecraft, rovers, landers and scientific instruments, along with their historical and scientific contributions.

details:
Project Title: Beyond the Mission – Space Legacy Explorer

Beyond the Mission – Space Legacy Explorer is an interactive digital museum developed to preserve and explore the history of NASA's equipment left behind on the Moon and Mars. Our project addresses the lack of public awareness and accessible information about abandoned spacecraft, rovers, landers and scientific instruments, highlighting their missions, discoveries and lasting contributions.

We developed a web-based platform using Python and Streamlit, organised into interactive sections including Explore Moon, Explore Mars, Equipment Explorer, Mission Dashboard, Mission Timeline, Science and Discovery, Legacy Room and an educational Quiz. Users can explore historical missions, understand the purpose of different equipment, discover scientific achievements and learn about the legacy of space exploration.

Our project transforms complex scientific information into an engaging, organised and accessible learning experience. Its creativity lies in combining historical storytelling, scientific information and interactive educational features within one platform.

We considered usability, educational value, accessibility, scientific accuracy, information organisation and user engagement during development. The project aims to inspire students, educators and space enthusiasts, encourage scientific curiosity and preserve the history of humanity's exploration beyond Earth.

Our vision is to demonstrate that even when a space mission ends, its discoveries and contributions continue to inspire future generations.
